subject: german
title: D-A-CH Lander
welcome_lead: German is spoken across Germany, Austria, Switzerland (D-A-CH). Each country has distinct culture and politics.
meta_desc: IBDP German: D-A-CH countries — comparison of Germany, Austria, Switzerland.
final_note: Three countries, one language, three cultures.

concepts.def: Acronym for Deutschland, Austria, Confoederatio Helvetica.

walkthroughs.body_html: 83 million people, federal republic since 1949. Reunified 1990. Member of EU and NATO.
9 million people, federal republic. Permanently neutral since 1955. Joined EU in 1995.
8.5 million, federal confederation. Not in EU. Four official languages: German, French, Italian, Romansh.
